input: Scheduled routine: continue work on the repo aiming to develop, deploy, market, sell and support revenue generating software products; merge when done.
task: Deepen (flagship 12): ids-model-check -- CI runner parses each model once for all its IDS
errors: Ran two 64-IDS benchmarks concurrently with a test that hung (the truncated-XML bug); the container hit its memory limit and the kernel killed processes. Re-ran one at a time with a peak-memory probe.

A git stash/stash-pop meant to compare against main ran on a clean tree (the work was already committed), so that one comparison actually ran the branch's code; redone against the git-archive copy of main in the scratchpad.

doc_friction.issue: ids-model-check buildable listed "Write dataType" (typeRow), which eval/untyped-values-2026-11-17.md shows already landed; replaced it in this PR with the open dataType-mismatch hint.

portfolio-pages build copies gitignored, untracked files under ventures/<slug>/eval/corpus (fetched by eval/fetch-audit-corpus.sh) into dist, so check.mjs fails locally on .csproj/.sln/.ids types that CI never sees; deleting the corpus first avoids it.

goal: Deepen a flagship: make the IDS GitHub Action / ci-cli usable on a real repository of exports and IDS files.
notes: ci-cli.mjs parses each model and IDS once (8 pairs on 4 real opensourceBIM exports: 8.2-8.7 s -> 4.3-4.8 s; 56 pairs with 14 public IDS: 48.6-48.9 s -> 7.5-8.0 s, peak 1.55 GB -> 0.85 GB; stdout identical, JSON identical up to the failure cap). Found with 16 public IDS: a spec with no entity facet applies to all 665,224 MEP entities and the old runner OOMs at Node's 2 GB heap; checkIds now takes maxFailed (ci-cli default 1000, --max-failures / action input max-failures), counts exact via failedCount. Found while testing: parseXml and parseStep looped forever on truncated input (indexOf -1 sent the cursor back to 0); both now throw 'unterminated ...', every prefix of the sample STEP file ends. Local checks: node --test *.test.mjs in ventures/ids-model-check 111 pass, 1 skipped; run_workflow_locally --for-changes: ventures-tests and others green, prompts-ci failed only on this record's unfilled outcome (filled now), portfolio-pages 'Check the built artifact' failed only on the local untracked eval/corpus (deleted; not in the tree).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: senior JS engineer: profile CI runner, refactor to parse once, diagnose OOM on public IDS, fix two parser hangs with tests, benchmark and write up

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
